summary: Surfaced verify_claim.insufficiency in the existing library search/verify audit UI (frontend/app.js verifyClaim). Added a new renderInsufficiency(ins) helper + INSUFFICIENCY_SUMMARY_LABEL map; the verify template now injects a dense, scannable audit block showing summary label, blocking state, missing_markers, conflict_count, lexical overlap counts/ratio, a details list (code + message), and the method string. Backward compatible: when insufficiency is absent (older responses) the helper returns '' and existing status/reasons/evidence_map rendering is untouched. All values escaped via the existing escapeHtml. No backend change. Wording is deterministic-lexical audit only (explicitly not semantic entailment / NLI / truth).
implemented: frontend/app.js: added INSUFFICIENCY_SUMMARY_LABEL (no_retrieved_evidence / required_markers_missing / conflict_candidates_found / weak_lexical_overlap / none -> honest Chinese audit labels).

frontend/app.js: added renderInsufficiency(ins) -> returns '' when ins is falsy (backward compatible), else a single dense `<div class="item ...">` audit row. Uses escapeHtml for all dynamic content; 'warning' class only when blocking, plain row when not blocking / summary none (no alarming wording).

frontend/app.js: verifyClaim() now computes insufficiencyHtml = renderInsufficiency(data.insufficiency) and injects it into the #searchResults template right after the status conclusion item and before the marker-coverage block. Existing status/reasons/evidence_map/covered_markers/supporting_items/cited_chunk_ids rendering is unchanged.

Audit row shows: summary label + has_insufficiency; blocking state; missing_markers; conflict_count; overlap (overlap_token_count / claim_token_count, overlap_ratio %, coverage_ratio %); details list (code + message, plus markers/conflict_count/conflict_types when present); method string with an explicit 'not semantic entailment / NLI / truth' note.
